info.about: Buck Bumble is a 3D third-person shooter video game developed by Argonaut Software, that was published in 1998 by UbiSoft for the Nintendo 64. The game's premise centers around a war of two factions of anthropomorphic insects, created as a result of a chemical spill in London.
info.trivia: Composer Justin Scharvona scored the whole game in speed garage, judging techno and jungle to be overdone.
info.why: Its theme song became an internet meme, giving an obscure 1998 shooter a modern resurgence of popularity.
